definitions: A pungent, salty, amber-coloured sauce made from fermented fish, especially anchovies, and used as a condiment or ingredient in Southeast Asian cuisine, particularly Vietnamese.
A fermented fish sauce originating from Vietnam, used to add umami and saltiness to dishes.
examples: She added a dash of nước mắm to the stir-fry.
The recipe calls for a tablespoon of nước mắm.
Nước mắm is a staple in Vietnamese cooking.
